We started Ancestral Nutrition for a straightforward reason: people stopped eating beef liver, and we wanted to bring it back in a way that actually fits modern life.

Intertitre · What are beef liver capsules?
Texte · Beef liver capsules are simply gelatin…
blocks_element.text: Beef liver capsules are simply gelatin capsules containing dried beef liver and nothing else. The dried liver is milled into a powder and served in a capsule for maximum convenience to avoid the smell and taste of beef liver. Our beef liver capsules only contain two ingredients, the capsule and the beef liver powder - no fillers or flow agents.

blocks_element.repere: Intertitre · What are the benefits of taking beef l…
blocks_element.text: What are the benefits of taking beef liver capsules?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · The primary benefit is gaining the nut…
blocks_element.text: The primary benefit is gaining the nutritional density of traditional organ meats with ultimate convenience. Our capsules allow you to easily incorporate a natural, whole-food source of Vitamin B12 and retinol (Vitamin A) into your daily routine without the need to source, prepare, or taste fresh liver.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Beef liver is naturally rich in nutrie…

blocks_element.repere: Texte · In Australia, the Recommended Dietary …
blocks_element.text: In Australia, the Recommended Dietary Intake (RDI) for vitamin A during pregnancy is 800 - 1000  µg of retinol equivalents (RE) per day. Our freeze-dried beef liver capsules provide a moderate 240 µg RE per 2g serve — well within recommended daily limits when included as part of a balanced diet.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Even so, we recommend speaking with yo…
